 19-year-old UF student killed while crossing West University Avenue
 Hazel Krauss died after being struck by a car Saturday night
 By Grace Larson 
 October 26, 2026 | 11:51am EDT 
 Flowers were laid outside the Delta Gamma house, Sunday, Oct. 25, 2026, in Gainesville, Fla.
 Photo by Tessa Davidson |
 The Independent Florida Alligator
 A car accident on West University Avenue Saturday night left a UF student dead. 
 Around 11:30 p.m. Saturday, a vehicle was driving on West University Ave. According to Gainesville Police Department spokesperson Art Forgey, the driver swerved to avoid hitting another vehicle. 
 As the driver swerved, the left side of his vehicle struck 19-year-old Hazel Krauss, a UF student who was crossing the street. The driver also hit the other vehicle with the right side of his car. 
 A nurse on the scene responded to Krauss until emergency medical services arrived. Krauss was transported to UF Health Shands Hospital where she later died.
 Users have taken to online platforms like YikYak to attempt to identify the driver. Some suggested Jack Bour, a 19-year-old Gainesville man, was involved in the crash. 
 According to his arrest report, Bour was charged with driving under the influence after he drove around a police vehicle blocking traffic during the investigation. Bour’s arrest was separate from the initial incident.
 The investigation is ongoing, Forgey said, and no arrests have been made.
